Docs tree

authoring             Build an npm package that adds components, templates, themes, docs, and codemods to Astryx apps,
                      and look up every field of every file it holds. - @astryxdesign/cli
calendars             Show dates in the Persian, Hebrew, Islamic, Buddhist, Japanese, lunisolar, and other calendars
                      while values stay Gregorian ISO dates. - @astryxdesign/cli
cli                   Commands, programmatic APIs, and output contracts. Building an integration is under `astryx docs
                      authoring`. - @astryxdesign/cli
foundations           Color, elevation, icons, illustrations, motion, shape, and spacing: the visual foundations every
                      component builds on. Each topic keeps its own name; open one by it. - @astryxdesign/cli
global                Install Astryx once on your computer and use it in any folder. Each project still runs its own
                      version of Astryx, so a global install never changes what a project gets. - @astryxdesign/cli
guides                Guides that stand on their own: getting started, principles, theming, and working with AI. Each
                      topic keeps its own name; open one by it. - @astryxdesign/cli
internationalization  Set the active locale, load catalogs, coexist with your own i18n library, show other calendars,
                      handle RTL, and test translations. - @astryxdesign/cli
layout                Build an app layout outside-in: scaffold the regions, structure the content, tune the spacing,
                      then adapt across widths. - @astryxdesign/cli
migration             Migrate an existing Tailwind, shadcn, or Radix app to the design system incrementally - setup,
                      component replacement, and verification. - @astryxdesign/cli
styling               Customize component appearance: xstyle, Tailwind, className, rest props, compound components, data
                      attribute selectors, tokens, and StyleX setup. - @astryxdesign/cli
styling-libraries     Integrate Tailwind, StyleX, Panda, Chakra, MUI, CSS-in-JS, CSS Modules, and non-CSS renderers with
                      system tokens. - @astryxdesign/cli
tokens                Complete reference for color, data visualization, syntax, spacing, size, border, focus, radius,
                      shadow, motion, and typography tokens. - @astryxdesign/cli
typography            Font families, geometric type scale, weight, line-height, and semantic text tokens for consistent,
                      accessible text styling. - @astryxdesign/cli

Topics

author-a-theme    Create, customize, and build a theme: defineTheme, palette generation, token overrides, component
                  style overrides, custom variants, responsive adaptations, and production builds. - @astryxdesign/cli
browser-support   What browsers Astryx targets, which modern platform features it depends on, and how to support older
                  browsers for your own audience. - @astryxdesign/cli
color             Semantic color tokens for surfaces, text, icons, borders, and status indicators. - @astryxdesign/cli
elevation         Shadow tokens for visual elevation and inset state rings. - @astryxdesign/cli
getting-started   Add the design system to your project and start building. - @astryxdesign/cli
icons             Semantic icon names available in the design system. These adapt to the active theme's icon registry. -
                  @astryxdesign/cli
illustrations     Illustration guidelines for empty states, onboarding flows, and feature highlights. -
                  @astryxdesign/cli
is-my-code-good   Check whether a product surface fits its app and uses Astryx well, require evidence for every claim,
                  and improve it with a repeatable agent review. - @astryxdesign/cli
motion            Duration and easing tokens for animations and transitions. - @astryxdesign/cli
principles        Core design principles and rules for building with the design system. - @astryxdesign/cli
shape             Border radius tokens for consistent component rounding, from sharp corners to full pills. -
                  @astryxdesign/cli
spacing           Spacing scale tokens for padding, gap, and margin: the rhythmic foundation of design system layouts. -
                  @astryxdesign/cli
styling-overview  How to set up CSS - exact imports for three paths: plain, Tailwind, and StyleX for your own code -
                  plus the stylesheet each Astryx package ships. - @astryxdesign/cli
theme             How to use and create themes: see Use a theme for applying themes, and Author a theme for creating and
                  customizing them. - @astryxdesign/cli
use-a-theme       Apply a theme to your app: install, import with the CLI, wire the generated module, switch dark mode,
                  nest themes, and choose runtime or built for production. - @astryxdesign/cli
use-integrations  Install, discover, and use integration packages that add components, templates, themes, and docs to
                  your app. - @astryxdesign/cli
working-with-ai   How to set up AI coding tools to generate correct component code. - @astryxdesign/cli

Usage: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs <topic>                  list a topic's sections
       npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs <topic> <section>        read one section
       npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs <topic> --full           read the whole topic
       npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/api                  go down the docs tree one level at a time
       npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli --depth all          every doc below cli, one line each
With --json, a topic returns its whole doc; add --index for its section list.

Next step: run `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 init` to finish setup and install the Astryx agent prompt.
